svg.text: BODY ENVELOPE REVIEW / NOT A KICAD 3D SCREENSHOT
No vendor CAD detail. Passive/header heights and cable/latch motion remain unverified.
Board: 42 x 38 x 1.0 mm. M2 holes: 2.2 mm NPTH; copper/body keepout radius 2.6 mm.
Models: J1/J2, U1-U4 and L1/L2 body envelopes. Excludes terminals, latch travel and FFC bend.
Flat gold pads are NOT assembled parts; unknown-height passives and manual headers omitted.
REVIEW HOLD: FFC mapping, panel bias limits, native ERC/DRC, impedance and SMT orientation are NOT signed off.
